name.value: Best Western King George Inn & Suites

description.value: A Best Western-branded hotel on Surrey's King George Boulevard, offering standard chain hotel rooms and an indoor pool available year-round. The property is positioned along a major arterial corridor in the Fraser Valley, making it a straightforward base camp for cyclists exploring the Surrey–Langley area. As part of the Best Western Rewards program, it caters to a wide range of travellers including families.

address.value: 8033 King George Boulevard, Surrey, BC V3W 5B4
